I'm sorry, your BC04 still hasn't shipped. It's 10 days since you ordered on October 31, and you should have had it by now.

The BC04 is in stock at our Tennessee warehouse. Your order is stuck on a packing hold there, and I can't clear that myself, so I don't have a ship date yet.

The team is offline right now. I've passed this on again, along with your question about the Labs bolts. They'll pick it up today at 10am ET, and the answer will come to (email hidden) Your tracking will go there too once it ships.
You're welcome. Before you go, one quick question: where did you hear about the Labs sign-up?
